evidence.field: 形義源流通解; graphic history and attestation
evidence.text: The entry reports 后 in late Spring and Autumn bronze inscriptions with the sense ‘ruler’. It says bronze forms distinguish right-facing 后 from left-facing 司, while oracle forms do not distinguish orientation; it attributes the same-graph account to Tang Lan and Li Xiaoding. Separately, it reports Wang Guowei’s identification of an oracle form written with 毓. The source does not establish a complete graphic sequence into received 后 or a settled component decomposition.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：后

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The opened entry says 后 and 後 were originally unrelated graphs, but homophonous, and cites transmitted-text uses of 后 for 後 in Yili 大射 and Liji 大學. It also notes such spellings in Song–Yuan and later popular literature, and reports that mainland simplified-character tables issued in 1964 and 1986 used 后 as the simplified form of 後. This supports a whole-graph spelling loan and later standardization; it does not establish the loan’s earliest occurrence or independently prove an ancient sound match.
evidence.title: [A01287] 後 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: 《說文》; 《廣韻》; pronunciation and graphic account
evidence.text: The entry displays 后 as U+540E, links 後 as the corresponding simplified form, reproduces Shuowen’s account of a command-giving successor ruler analyzed with 一 and 口, and lists Guangyun fanqie 胡口 and 胡遘. It also repeats the competing early-form accounts. The Shuowen decomposition is a historical lexicographic analysis, not independent proof of the graph’s origin.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：后

evidence.field: Description, original-file link, file history and license
evidence.text: The exact file page describes 後-seal.svg as 後 in Shuowen seal-script style, links its source picture to Xiaoxuetang record 27.5F8C, and states CC0 1.0. The page identifies the original SVG link and upload history. This is a modern vector redraw for the received graph 後, not an image of 后 and not evidence for 后’s disputed early form.

evidence.field: A01287-012; distinction of graphs and spelling substitution
evidence.text: The dictionary expressly distinguishes the original graph 后 from 後, then explains later textual borrowing and standardized simplification. Thus the classical whole-graph use is separate from a sound component inside 后. Its statement of homophony is a lexicographic account; the available inspected evidence does not provide independently matched Old Chinese reconstructions establishing the ancient sound basis.

search_audit.outcome: Search located the Ministry dictionary entry. Opened the 後 record and inspected the exact research note: it distinguishes 后 and 後, cites Yili and Liji spelling substitutions, notes Song–Yuan and later popular-text examples, and reports 1964/1986 simplification.

Attempted the exact Commons description page, exact imageinfo API, and exact direct image. All failed with cache miss or inaccessible-URL errors. The local lead metadata was not treated as verification.

gaps: The earliest secure graphic account for 后 remains unresolved: the inspected source reports the 后/司 same-graph or orientation account and separately reports Wang Guowei’s oracle 毓 identification. No complete sequence into received 后 or secure component-by-component formation is established.

CUHK reports late Spring and Autumn bronze attestation for 后 as ‘ruler’, but the cited artifact edition was not independently inspected; the identity and dating of any earlier oracle forms remain unresolved.

The ruler, feudal-lord and ruler’s-wife senses have received-text citations, but the inspected dictionaries do not date transitions among them or establish the proposed childbirth-to-succession chain. The rear-body interpretation is likewise unsupported by the inspected paleographic sources.

The opened Ministry dictionary supports textual spelling use of 后 for 後 and later standardization, but does not establish the first loan date or independently substantiate the ancient sound match. Modern hòu homophony is not ancient phonological evidence.

The local Unihan rows for 后, 後 and 口 and local Baxter–Sagart rows were checked as supplied. The official character-specific Unihan records and Baxter–Sagart upstream PDF remained inaccessible, so their local rows are not claimed as independently verified external readings.

The exact Commons page and imageinfo request for 后-seal.svg failed. Commons alternatives located here either depict the unrelated graph 後 in seal style or 后 as a modern stroke-order graphic; no verified reusable image that helps explain 后’s supported graphic history was selected. The exact direct image for 後-seal.svg also failed to fetch despite its verified file page and CC0 metadata.
No tracked source extract is recommended. The inspected sources are individual character dictionary pages or file records, and no broad permission to reproduce dictionary text was established.

limitations.text: No selected image: the exact 后-seal.svg Commons page and imageinfo lookup were inaccessible, so its identity and reported public-domain status could not be verified in this run. A separately verified Commons CC0 seal redraw is explicitly 後, not 后; using it would illustrate the wrong graph. The inspected后 stroke-order search result is a modern instructional graphic, not a historical form candidate.

The early forms and graphic history of 后 remain disputed. The inspected evidence reports competing 后/司 and 毓 accounts but does not establish a complete lineage, corruption path or secure component decomposition; no selected image resolves that question.
